decoder.parity_check_matrix: the checks, as a 0/1 matrix, row j = check j

logical.rule: r = answer XOR sampled fault (both as 0/1 vectors over the n columns); a logical error iff some check of the dataset has odd overlap with r, or r is not in the GF(2) row space of stabilizer_rows

samples.note: a replay reads these values; it never re-samples (a seeded sampler need not reproduce across machines, library versions or sampling procedures)
samples.sampler: numpy.random.default_rng(seed); fault = rng.random(n) < p_i per draw
samples.what: the sampled fault of every nontrivial shot, as a support

seed_rule: int(sha256(domain + '||' + dataset).hexdigest()[:16], 16) & (2**63 - 1), reduced modulo 2**31 - 1 for bb_refsched
